description: Coverage registry for AI Workspace Proxy features and policy permissions. Empty tests arrays mean no automated test is currently attached.

test_entry_schema.test_script: Repository-relative path to the test file or script used to run the test.
test_entry_schema.live: Optional boolean. True means the test touches a real external service and is only run by testing/start-test.py when --live TEST_ACCOUNT_EMAIL is provided.

items.name: Configuration validation
items.summary: Load and validate environment configuration, including required OAuth settings, allowed email domains, admins, and encryption key format.

tests.test_summary: Verifies encryption keys must be 32 raw bytes, 64 hex characters, or base64 for exactly 32 bytes, and rejects weak strings.

items.name: Policy catalog validation
items.summary: Validate that every policy capability has consistent metadata, valid rules, and explicit risk information before server startup.

tests.test_summary: Verifies the policy catalog validates successfully, including risk score and risk explanation coverage.
Verifies the system default policy includes every Low-risk capability and excludes all Medium/High-risk capabilities.
Verifies every policy permission offered by the catalog is present in the coverage registry and has at least one automated test entry.

items.name: Proxy Google login
items.summary: Allow users to sign in to the proxy with verified Google accounts under allowed email domains.

tests.test_summary: Verifies successful Google login creates a browser session using the authenticated user's configured session duration.
Verifies proxy login pauses at a second-factor challenge when the user has enrolled 2FA.

items.name: Session and CSRF protection
items.summary: Maintain browser sessions and require CSRF tokens for state-changing dashboard actions.

tests.test_summary: Verifies a state-changing settings form uses the current session, refreshes its expiry, and returns the updated browser-session metadata.
Verifies the logged-in browser flow can start, confirm, and reset a CSRF-protected 2FA enrollment sequence.

items.name: Logout
items.summary: Allow users to invalidate their browser session and clear the session cookie.

items.name: User timezone settings
items.summary: Allow each user to select a local timezone and render timestamps according to that preference.

tests.test_summary: Verifies the activity-log column catalog exposes one user-timezone timestamp column instead of separate local and UTC timestamp defaults.
Verifies activity-log date filtering is evaluated in the user's configured timezone.

items.name: Workspace OAuth connection
items.summary: Allow a proxy user to connect Google Workspace accounts and store encrypted OAuth tokens for each account.

tests.test_summary: Verifies the Workspace OAuth callback rejects a mismatched Google account and preserves the previously stored Workspace tokens.

items.name: Workspace OAuth token refresh
items.summary: Refresh Workspace access tokens from encrypted refresh tokens before forwarding Google requests.

items.name: Multiple Workspace accounts
items.summary: Allow one proxy user to manage multiple connected Workspace accounts selected by friendly name or email.

tests.test_summary: Verifies the privileged Workspace API lists multiple connected Workspace accounts and resolves one Workspace by friendly name or email.

items.name: Workspace friendly names
items.summary: Allow users to edit non-empty friendly names and resolve ambiguous names safely.

items.name: Workspace ordering preference
items.summary: Persist user-defined left-menu Workspace ordering and add newly connected Workspaces at the top.

items.name: Workspace disconnect
items.summary: Allow users to disconnect a Workspace account and synchronize related stored preferences.

tests.test_summary: Verifies disconnecting a Workspace clears stored OAuth tokens while preserving local Workspace settings.
Verifies deleting Workspace settings removes the local proxy-side Workspace configuration.

items.name: Agent API key management
items.summary: Create, download, and rotate per-agent API keys used by AI agents for grant- and policy-enforced Google Workspace operations.

tests.test_summary: Verifies the downloaded agent config uses the current filename, the decrypted agent API key, and the granted Workspace list.
Verifies agent API keys are shown through shortened hints rather than full raw secrets in the UI.

items.name: End-user backend API key management
items.summary: Create, download, and rotate the privileged per-user API key reserved for user-owned backend configuration clients.

items.name: Privileged user configuration API
items.summary: Allow user-owned privileged API clients to manage user-level proxy settings, policies, agent Workspace grants, and test setup without bypassing policy enforcement for Google Workspace operations.

tests.test_summary: Verifies agent API keys cannot access privileged user configuration APIs.
Verifies privileged clients can create, update, apply, and delete custom policies while preserving policy state.
Verifies the system policy cannot be created, updated, or deleted, but can be applied.
Verifies the privileged Workspace API rejects agent API keys and returns Workspace identity without policy assignment fields.
Verifies privileged clients can read and update per-agent Drive folder grants while agent API keys are rejected.

items.name: Download proxy API config files
items.summary: Generate `agents-workspace-api-access.config.json` for AI agents and `user-backend-api-access.config.json` for user-owned backend configuration clients.

tests.test_summary: Verifies the agent config filename, decrypted agent token field, granted Workspace sorting, and Drive folder grant output.

items.name: Permissions editor
items.summary: Allow users to create, edit, delete, and choose default custom policies from friendly capability cards.

tests.test_summary: Verifies Calendar policy capabilities are grouped into Events Operations and Calendars Operations, then sorted by risk and title.
Verifies comment permissions are grouped into their own Comments subsection, then sorted by risk and title.
Verifies Drive file permissions include labels and revisions, are sorted by risk and title, and do not expose a drive-management subsection.
Verifies Gmail policy capabilities are grouped into Emails, Labels, and Mailbox subsections, then sorted by risk and title.

items.name: Agent Workspace grants
items.summary: Allow users to create agent identities, attach one or more Workspace accounts, select which policy applies to each agent/Workspace grant, and scope Drive folder access per Workspace grant.

tests.test_summary: Verifies agent Workspace grants persist selected Workspace, policy, and accountability settings without losing the selected agent context.
Verifies per-agent Drive folder grants can be updated, survive folder Reference Name changes, are removed when a folder is deleted, and produce user audit logs.
Verifies the privileged user API supports per-agent Drive folder grant setup for automation and live tests.

items.name: Google API proxy relay
items.summary: Authenticate proxy API calls, resolve Workspace identity, enforce policy, and forward allowed requests to Google.

tests.test_summary: Verifies the relay normalizes structured Google method separators such as `:batchUpdate` before policy matching and forwarding.
Verifies the relay only accepts the supported People API contact-search routes.
Verifies the relay rejects agent requests missing a required motive on grants that enforce accountability.

items.name: Per-user request logging
items.summary: Log per-user proxy request outcomes, provide an advanced consolidated activity-log console with filtering/export, enforce per-grant agent accountability and human approval logging, and clean up retained logs automatically.

tests.test_summary: Verifies request logging remains enabled, standard retention stays fixed at 7 days, request logs persist correctly, and expired entries are cleaned up.
Verifies logged agent identity and motive metadata are rejected when missing or oversized.
Verifies agent skill self-update downloads are logged as agent activity and include the expected context fields.
Verifies request and audit logging remain enabled for standard users.
Verifies user-facing account, settings, and configuration actions are captured in audit logs with meaningful targets and details.
Verifies retention-day parsing still clamps to the standard-user limit used by the cleanup layer.
Verifies request-log view settings changes are audited without mutating unrelated user settings.
Verifies request-log column view settings and page size persist per user.
Verifies request-log regex filtering, pagination, and export projection helpers.
Verifies CSV exports prefix formula-like values to reduce spreadsheet injection risk.

items.name: Allowed Drive folder management
items.summary: Allow users to register, update, refresh, and delete allowed Drive folder references per Workspace.

tests.test_summary: Verifies privileged clients can list allowed Drive folder references for a Workspace while agent API keys are rejected.

items.name: Drive subfolder tree cache
items.summary: Recursively discover Drive subfolders, cache them in SQLite, and use the cache for subfolder operations.

tests.test_summary: Verifies cached Drive folder grants stay aligned when registered folders are renamed or deleted, which depends on the stored folder-reference state.

items.name: Drive folder tree API
items.summary: Expose proxy APIs for agents to list and refresh cached Drive folder trees.

tests.test_summary: Verifies Drive-facing agent requests are blocked until the Workspace grant has allowed Drive folder references available to the tree API and request rewriter.

items.name: Drive and structured file request rewriting
items.summary: Rewrite Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides requests so creates/searches stay inside allowed folder trees.

tests.test_summary: Verifies Drive requests are denied before policy evaluation when the agent has Workspace access but no allowed Drive folder grants.

items.name: Agent skill generation
items.summary: Build policy-filtered agent skill zip packages containing config, scripts, and Workspace-specific Markdown files.

tests.test_summary: Verifies generated skill Markdown adds the required human-review notice to operations whose permissions require approval.
Verifies generated agent config output is scoped to the selected agent and Workspace list.

items.name: Agent skill install tokens
items.summary: Create single-use 10-minute download tokens for local agent skill installation.

tests.test_summary: Verifies token-based dashboard downloads are treated as user-driven install activity rather than agent request traffic.

items.name: Agent skill install and bootstrap scripts
items.summary: Install, bootstrap, and update generated skill packages for Generic and OpenClaw targets.

tests.test_name: Shell syntax checks for agent skill scripts
tests.test_summary: Verifies generated install, bootstrap, and update shell scripts parse successfully with `sh -n`.

tests.test_name: Python syntax check for workspace proxy tool
tests.test_summary: Verifies the generated Python proxy helper compiles with `python3 -m py_compile`.

tests.test_name: Update skill forwards agent logging context
tests.test_summary: Verifies update_skill.sh accepts agent identity options and forwards them to the proxy helper for logging enforcement.

items.name: Admin user management
items.summary: Allow configured admins to list users, inspect user stats, suspend, unsuspend, and delete users.

items.name: SQLite persistence
items.summary: Persist users, sessions, OAuth states, tokens, Workspaces, policies, Drive references, Drive tree cache, stats, and agent skill tokens.

items.name: Dashboard user interface
items.summary: Render dashboard, left navigation, settings, policy editor, Workspace management, Drive folder management, and install overlays.

tests.test_summary: Verifies section activation and breadcrumb/page-title rendering stay consistent across the main dashboard surfaces.
Verifies the dashboard renders the KPI cards and onboarding content.
Verifies key Workspace-management controls keep the intended compact sizing classes.
Verifies the activity-log browser stays constrained within its section and supports internal scrolling.
Verifies the agents page renders Workspace grants, accountability controls, and scoped skill-download UI.

items.name: Read calendars and events
items.summary: Allow agents to list calendars and read calendar events without changing them.

tests.test_summary: Verifies Calendar read permission allows calendar list, calendar metadata, event read, instances, and free/busy routes while denying event creation.

tests.test_name: Live Calendar read calendars and events
tests.test_summary: Reads calendar list entries, calendar metadata, events, event details, and free/busy data through the proxy, then verifies create attempts are denied.

items.name: Create or import myself-only events
items.summary: Allow agents to create or import new calendar events only when the request has no third-party attendees, no room/resource attendees, no additional guests, and no organizer or creator other than the connected user.

tests.test_summary: Verifies myself-only Calendar create/import permission allows solo events and denies third-party events.
Creates and imports myself-only Calendar events through the proxy, verifies third-party create/import attempts are denied, then cleans up and restores policy assignment.

items.name: Create or import events with third parties

tests.test_summary: Verifies third-party Calendar create/import permission allows guest/resource events and rejects myself-only events.

tests.test_name: Live Calendar create/import events with third parties
tests.test_summary: Creates and imports third-party Calendar events through the proxy, verifies myself-only create/import attempts are denied, then cleans up and restores policy assignment.

tests.test_name: Live Calendar update existing myself-only events

items.name: Update or move events with third parties

tests.test_summary: Verifies third-party Calendar update/move permission allows guest/resource event updates and move operations.

tests.test_name: Live Calendar update or move events with third parties

items.name: Delete existing myself-only events
